title: Literal Git revision expressions in PowerShell
failure_signature: An unquoted HEAD...@{upstream} divergence expression was transformed by PowerShell before Git received it.
candidate_workaround: Pass the revision expression as a single-quoted literal or resolve both revisions to exact hashes before comparison.
recurrence_guard: Quote Git revision expressions containing @{...} in PowerShell and never infer divergence state from a parser-failed probe.
rollback: Retain the failed probe, make no equality claim from it, and rerun only read-only hash and divergence resolution.
scope_boundary: This method validates Git-ref transport only; it does not validate repository contents, scientific claims, or independent reproduction.
